- **VR-00368** `major` Do not write parameters in prose (duration, resolution, aspect ratio, model). Set them as parameters. · check: `prose scan for '10 seconds','1080p','16:9'` — source: [OpenAI Sora 2 Prompting Guide](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/sora/sora2_prompting_guide)
- **VR-00369** `major` Match motion energy to the scene: quiet scenes use slow drifts; action uses fast moves. · check: `move.energy matches scene.energy` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00370** `major` For text-to-video shots (no keyframe), use the full master shot template: intent, subject, action, setting, camera, lighting, style, audio, continuity. · check: `all template fields present` — source: [OpenAI Sora 2 Prompting Guide](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/sora/sora2_prompting_guide)
- **VR-00371** `major` For chained shots, write the prompt as a continuation of the previous shot ('she reaches the door and pushes it open'). · check: `chain prompt references previous action` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00372** `major` State the travel direction for any moving subject or camera ('left to right', 'toward camera'). · check: `direction words present when motion` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00373** `major` Keep the video prompt under about 80 words for i2v and about 150 words for text-to-video; overloaded prompts degrade every instruction. · check: `word count check` — source: [OpenAI Sora 2 Prompting Guide](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/sora/sora2_prompting_guide)
- **VR-00374** `major` Phrase exclusions positively where possible: 'one clean face, steady hands' rather than a long 'no' list. · check: `<=3 'no' phrases outside audio` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00375** `major` Never ask for fine motor tasks the model fumbles: writing words, typing exact text, tying laces, dealing cards, playing a specific chord. · check: `fine-motor scan` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00376** `major` If the subject is high-risk (hands, dialogue, crowds, liquids), choose a static or slow camera move. · check: `risk 3 subjects use energy-1 moves` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00377** `minor` Describe light changes as events ('a cloud passes, the room dims') when the scene needs them; otherwise say nothing about light in i2v. · check: `light change only as event` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00378** `major` Reuse identical character anchor phrases in the video prompt when a character must be re-identified (text-to-video or long takes). · check: `anchors present in t2v` — source: [OpenAI Sora 2 Prompting Guide](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/sora/sora2_prompting_guide)

## Agent Read/Write Discipline

- **VR-00379** `block` Before writing any prompt, the agent loads: the lock sheet, the character/product sheets, the scene's sequence context, and the rules index for each subject, move and lighting it will use. · check: `load log lists all four` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00380** `block` The agent writes output only in the scene JSON schema. Free-form prose deliverables are rejected by the pipeline. · check: `schema validation passes` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00381** `block` The agent runs the linter on every scene spec and fixes every 'block' finding before handing off. · check: `lint report attached, zero blocks` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00382** `major` The agent cites rule IDs for every non-default choice in the scene spec's 'rationale' field. · check: `rationale lists rule IDs` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00383** `block` The agent never changes a lock-sheet value. It proposes a change in 'lock_change_request' and stops for the team head. · check: `lock unchanged` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00384** `block` The agent never invents facts, product features, statistics, names or quotes. Unknown facts are marked TODO_VERIFY and block generation. · check: `no TODO_VERIFY at generation time` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00385** `major` The agent looks up derived rules for every subject x move, subject x lighting and subject x framing combination it uses and applies their checks. · check: `derived rule IDs listed` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00386** `major` When two rules conflict, priority is: safety/rights > lock sheet > model capability > core rule > derived rule > style preference. Log the conflict. · check: `conflict log` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00387** `major` The agent writes one scene at a time, validates it, then moves on. It does not batch-write 20 scenes and validate later. · check: `per-scene lint timestamps` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00388** `major` The agent keeps a prompt log row for every take: shot ID, model, parameters, full prompts, result path, verdict, rule IDs implicated. · check: `log row per take` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00389** `major` The agent quotes the lock sheet's exact style string and color anchors; it never retypes them from memory. · check: `string equality` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00390** `major` The agent reports uncertainty explicitly (e.g., 'model may not hold the logo') instead of silently hoping. · check: `risks field non-empty for risk>=3` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00391** `block` The agent never claims a clip passed QA without the reviewer agent's signed checklist. · check: `reviewer signature present` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00392** `major` The agent treats vendor marketing features as unavailable until confirmed in this toolchain's model docs. · check: `capability check cites model doc` — source: Toolchain video model docs (verified Oct 2026)
- **VR-00393** `major` Writer and reviewer are separate roles; the writer never reviews its own clips. · check: `writer_id != reviewer_id` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00394** `major` The agent re-reads the rulebook version at the start of each project and records the version used. · check: `rules_version in project log` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00395** `minor` The agent writes prompts in the language that the video model handles best (English) while keeping all user-facing deliverables in the user's language. · check: `language fields set` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00396** `major` The agent stops and escalates after two failed takes on the same shot, attaching both prompts and the failure notes. · check: `take count <= 2 before escalation` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00397** `major` The agent treats every rule as a guard, not a guarantee: passing the linter does not mean the clip is good; only review does. · check: `review required regardless of lint` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00398** `block` The agent never deletes or overwrites a previous take; new takes get new IDs. · check: `files immutable` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)

## Mistake Prevention Self-Checks

- **VR-00399** `block` Before generation, confirm the model accepts the requested duration. · check: `duration in model.durations` — source: Toolchain video model docs (verified Oct 2026)
- **VR-00400** `block` Before generation, confirm the model honors the requested aspect ratio. · check: `aspect in model.aspects` — source: Toolchain video model docs (verified Oct 2026)
- **VR-00401** `major` Before generation, confirm reference image count does not exceed the model limit; extra images are silently dropped. · check: `len(refs) <= model.refs` — source: Toolchain video model docs (verified Oct 2026)
- **VR-00402** `major` Before generation, confirm the audio setting will actually be honored; if not, plan a strip step. · check: `audio_off honored or strip planned` — source: Toolchain video model docs (verified Oct 2026)
- **VR-00403** `block` Before generation, confirm the keyframe file exists, opens, and matches the aspect ratio. · check: `file exists and dims ratio ok` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00404** `major` Before generation, re-read the video prompt and delete any sentence that describes what the image already shows. · check: `overlap check` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00405** `major` Before generation, count camera move terms; if more than one, delete all but the intended one. · check: `move count` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00406** `major` Before generation, count dialogue words against the shot's word budget. · check: `dialogue budget` — source: [OpenAI Sora 2 Prompting Guide](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/sora/sora2_prompting_guide)
- **VR-00407** `major` Before generation, scan for banned quality slogans. · check: `banned word scan` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00408** `block` Before generation, scan for real-person names, celebrity references, third-party brands and evidence-like objects; resolve each. · check: `sensitivity scan` — source: Toolchain trust-boundaries policy
- **VR-00409** `major` Before generation, scan for on-screen text requests; move them to post. · check: `text scan` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00410** `major` Before generation, confirm the cost approval covers this generation. · check: `approval id present` — source: Toolchain media skill
- **VR-00411** `major` After generation, check that the output file exists before any retry; a timeout does not mean failure. · check: `file check before retry` — source: Toolchain media skill
- **VR-00412** `major` After generation, run ffprobe for duration, resolution, frame rate and audio stream presence. · check: `ffprobe fields logged` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00413** `major` After generation, extract first, middle and last frames and compare to the keyframe and character sheet. · check: `3 frames extracted` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00414** `major` After generation, watch the clip at full speed with sound, then step through the risk moments frame by frame. · check: `review notes include both passes` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00415** `major` After generation, listen for unrequested music, laughter, voices or subtitles burned into the frame. · check: `audio/text check` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00416** `major` After stitching a scene, confirm the total is 10.0s (+/- one frame). · check: `ffprobe scene duration` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00417** `major` After stitching, check the cut point for jump artifacts, color jumps and audio pops. · check: `cut review` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00418** `major` Before delivery, play the full export end to end; never deliver unwatched output. · check: `full playback logged` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00419** `major` Before delivery, confirm pixel format yuv420p so browsers can play the file. · check: `pix_fmt == yuv420p` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00420** `major` Before delivery, re-verify every on-screen number and claim against the source log. · check: `claims re-verified` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00421** `minor` Before delivery, confirm captions match final narration word-for-word. · check: `caption diff empty` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00422** `major` Before delivery, confirm no frame strobes or flashes rapidly (photosensitivity). · check: `flash review` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00423** `major` Before delivery, confirm the deliverable list in the lock sheet is complete. · check: `deliverables checklist` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)

## Audio Inside 10-Second Scenes

- **VR-00424** `major` Pick one audio strategy per scene: native audio, TTS VO over silent picture, or native ambience + TTS VO. · check: `scene.audio_strategy set` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00425** `major` Narration-first for narrated scenes: generate the scene's VO, measure it, confirm it is under 9.5s, then plan shots. · check: `vo duration logged before shots` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00426** `major` If the VO is longer than 9.5s, shorten the script and regenerate; never speed it up. · check: `no atempo` — source: Toolchain speech guide
- **VR-00427** `major` Ambience must be continuous across the scene's internal cut; if shot 1 and shot 2 have different native ambience, lay one ambience bed under both in post. · check: `ambience bed decision` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00428** `major` Mix VO over native ambience with ambience around 0.3 and VO at 1.0, amix duration=longest. · check: `mix command used` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00429** `major` TTS delivery comes from wording, punctuation and bracket tags like [short pause]; never use emotion words as tags, the model reads them aloud. · check: `tag whitelist` — source: Toolchain speech guide
- **VR-00430** `minor` Use the same TTS voice for the narrator across all scenes; record it in the lock sheet. · check: `voice constant` — source: Toolchain speech guide
- **VR-00431** `major` Dialogue lines in native audio clips must be checked for exact words; models may change or drop words. · check: `transcript matches script` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00432** `major` If silence is required and the model forces audio, strip it: ffmpeg -i in.mp4 -c:v copy -an out.mp4. · check: `audio stream absent` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00433** `minor` Put a sound cue on the scene's main beat (a door click, a whoosh) so the edit has rhythm. · check: `sfx cue on beat` — source: [OpenAI Sora 2 Prompting Guide](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/sora/sora2_prompting_guide)

## Post-Production Commands

- **VR-00434** `major` Hard-cut concat: ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i list.txt -c copy scene.mp4, only when all clips share codec, resolution and frame rate; otherwise re-encode. · check: `stream params equal or re-encode` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00435** `major` Crossfade: xfade offset = first clip duration minus transition duration; a 0.5s dissolve shortens the pair by 0.5s, so plan for it. · check: `offset math logged` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00436** `major` Use -preset fast or medium on the 2-vCPU sandbox; never slow/slower/veryslow. · check: `preset check` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00437** `major` Use -crf 23 general, 26-28 social, 18-20 archival. · check: `crf by deliverable` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00438** `block` Always output -pix_fmt yuv420p. · check: `pix_fmt` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00439** `major` Set a bash timeout of at least 5 minutes for any ffmpeg command. · check: `timeout >= 300000` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00440** `major` Editorial trim (e.g., 12s to 10s): ffmpeg -ss <start> -i in.mp4 -t 10 -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac out.mp4. · check: `trim re-encodes for frame accuracy` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00441** `major` Extract last frame for chaining: ffmpeg -sseof -0.1 -i clip.mp4 -frames:v 1 -q:v 2 last.jpg. · check: `command used` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00442** `major` Never re-encode to shrink file size at the cost of quality; deliver full quality. · check: `no size-driven downscale` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00443** `major` Vertical conversion from landscape: crop=ih*9/16:ih,scale=1080:1920, and check that the subject survives the crop. · check: `crop review` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00444** `minor` For vertical captions with ASS subtitles, set PlayResX 1080 and PlayResY 1920. · check: `ASS header` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00445** `major` Do not create titles with ffmpeg drawtext; use generated title images animated as video, or a proper caption file. · check: `no drawtext titles` — source: Toolchain video production guide

## Reviewer Agent QA

- **VR-00446** `block` Reviewer checks each clip against its scene spec field by field: subject, action beats, end state, move, lighting, audio. · check: `field checklist` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00447** `block` Reviewer checks identity against the character/product sheet using first, middle and last frames. · check: `3-frame compare` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00448** `major` Reviewer counts fingers, limbs and subjects at peak-motion frames. · check: `counts logged` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00449** `major` Reviewer reads every visible glyph; any gibberish fails the clip unless it can be masked. · check: `text verdict` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00450** `major` Reviewer verifies lip sync and exact dialogue words. · check: `dialogue verdict` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00451** `major` Reviewer listens for hallucinated audio and burned-in subtitles. · check: `audio verdict` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00452** `major` Reviewer checks rigid objects and architecture for warping during camera moves. · check: `geometry verdict` — source: Toolchain video model docs (verified Oct 2026)
- **VR-00453** `major` Reviewer checks the final 1 second for collapse, freeze or morph. · check: `tail verdict` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00454** `major` Reviewer checks screen direction and eyeline continuity across the scene's cut and into the next scene. · check: `continuity verdict` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00455** `major` Reviewer verdict is one of PASS, PASS-WITH-TRIM (state cut points), FAIL (state rule IDs). No vague verdicts. · check: `verdict enum` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00456** `major` Reviewer attaches the rule IDs implicated in every FAIL so the writer can fix the cause, not the symptom. · check: `rule IDs on FAIL` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00457** `block` Reviewer fails any clip with strobing, sexualized content, realistic minors in sensitive contexts, real-person deception, third-party IP or fake evidence. · check: `safety verdict` — source: Toolchain trust-boundaries policy
- **VR-00458** `major` Reviewer checks color anchors and style against the lock sheet; drift beyond a light grade fails. · check: `style verdict` — source: [OpenAI Sora 2 Prompting Guide](https://developers.openai.com/cookbook/examples/sora/sora2_prompting_guide)
- **VR-00459** `major` Reviewer signs and timestamps the checklist; unsigned clips cannot enter the edit. · check: `signature` — source: Team convention (heuristic; amend from post-mortems)
- **VR-00460** `major` Reviewer re-checks the stitched scene, not just the individual clips. · check: `scene-level verdict` — source: Toolchain video production guide

## Cost & Approval Control

- **VR-00461** `block` Video is billed per second. Get explicit approval with the cost stated before generating more than one clip. · check: `approval logged` — source: Toolchain media skill
- **VR-00462** `major` One 10-second scene = at least two clips (or one 12s clip). State this when estimating a sequence: a 60s video is at least 12 clips. · check: `clip count in estimate` — source: Toolchain media skill
- **VR-00463** `major` Do not promise exact credit totals; state that longer videos cost more and confirm before proceeding. · check: `no exact credit promises` — source: Toolchain media skill
- **VR-00464** `major` Draft cheap first: validate keyframes (images) before spending on video. · check: `keyframes approved before video` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00465** `major` Turn audio off on Veo when the scene uses TTS only; it lowers cost. · check: `audio off when VO-only` — source: Toolchain video production guide
- **VR-00466** `major` Do not switch to a more expensive model as a reflex; a higher price is not a guaranteed quality upgrade. · check: `model switch reason logged` — source: Toolchain video model docs (verified Oct 2026)
- **VR-00467** `major` If generation succeeds but delivery fails, deliver the existing file; never regenerate to work around a sharing error. · check: `no duplicate generation` — source: Toolchain media skill

## Derived: Subject x Camera Move

- **VR-00468** `minor` Adult person walking with a static locked-off move: PREFERRED. Reason: it suits the subject's best framings (medium, wide) and most robust; lets subject motion carry the shot. Prompt fragment: "static locked-off camera, no camera movement; steady walking pace with natural arm swing". After generation, check for end-of-clip collapse: inspect the last 1 second closely.
